 Arjun Rampal in Blind Game (2026)
 |
 Soham Rockstar Entertainment/ThunderSky Entertainment/Zee Studios
 The Hindi film Blind Game is an adaptation of the Malayalam hit 7th Day (2014). Blind Game was completed in 2023 but was stalled because of the demise of its director, Sangeeth Sivan. The thriller, also written by Sivan, is out on Zee5.
 Arjun Rampal plays Sikandar, a suspended police officer who meets two young men in Manali. Vicky (Rohit Chandel) and Shaan (Akash Makhija) are on the run from a thug whose boss is the mysterious David Walter Williams, described by Sikandar as the “most dangerous criminal in Southeast Asia” who is also a “ghost” since very few people knows what he looks like.
 Vicky, Shaan and their friends Jerry (Nakul Sahdev), Jessica (Noyrika Bhateja) and Burger (Shayank Shukla) are in deep trouble with David’s henchmen. This quintet has stumbled upon a bag of money that belongs to David, and he has sent his employees to collect.
 The death of one of the friends piques Sikandar’s interest. Working with local inspector Yamini (Priyamani), Sikandar sets out to separate lies from the truth.
 It is not hard to see which way Blind Game is headed. Some movies aim to be little more than timepassers that can be watched on the go and with pauses, during lunch breaks or the long commute home. 
 The film is mostly poorly performed, with the exception of Arjun Rampal and Priyamani. A few of the twists are decent enough to justify the 113-minute length. There are a handful of chases to create the illusion of momentum.
